prep.text: ICA shop (list below). Put the 700 g chicken for Thu straight in the freezer.
Lunch: falafel makes 3, eat it all.
Dinner: Greek chicken makes 6. Box 2.5 for Sun lunch and 1 for Mon lunch; make the salad fresh each time.
Dinner: pastitsio makes 7 (about 1 h 40 min, half of it in the oven). Box 2.5 for Mon dinner and 1 for Tue lunch; freeze 1.
No cooking. Evening: move 800 g cod from freezer to fridge to thaw.
Dinner: curry makes 4. Box 1 with rice for Wed lunch.
Dinner: orzotto makes 4. Box 1 for Thu lunch. Evening: move the chicken and 400 g cod from freezer to fridge.
Dinner: noodle bowls make 4. Box 1 for Fri lunch with the dressing apart.
Assisted-quick dinner. Freezer buffer: 1 tagine + 1 pastitsio.

recipes.name: Air-fryer falafel pittas with tahini yoghurt & quick pickles
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, rinsed and patted dry
50 g frozen chopped onion (thawed, squeezed); a big handful of flat-leaf parsley; 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika; 1 lemon; black pepper
3 tbsp plain flour (vetemjöl), 1 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp olive oil
6 wholemeal pittas (fullkornspitabröd)
1 cucumber, thinly sliced; 2 tbsp rice vinegar; 3 tomatoes; 1 little gem lettuce
2 dl Turkish yoghurt, 2 tbsp tahini
steps: Blitz chickpeas, onion, parsley, spices, lemon zest, flour, baking powder, oil and pepper to a coarse paste (food processor or stick blender). Shape 18 small patties.
Brush with oil; air fry at 200°C for 12–14 min in both air fryers, turning halfway, until crisp.
Toss cucumber with the vinegar; leave 10 min.
Whisk yoghurt, tahini and the lemon juice.
Warm the pittas; fill with falafel, tomato, lettuce, pickles and sauce.

recipes.name: Greek lemon chicken & potatoes with village salad
ingredients: 1.2 kg chicken thigh fillets (kycklinglårfilé)
1.5 kg potatoes, scrubbed, in wedges; 3 dl water
3 lemons; 4 tbsp olive oil; 2 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried thyme; black pepper
3 dl Turkish yoghurt; fresh dill
Salad: 2 cucumbers, 4 tomatoes, 1 red pepper, 2 spring onions, 100 g kalamata olives, 100 g feta, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, olive oil, oregano
steps: Toss potatoes with half the oil, the juice of 2 lemons, the oregano, thyme and pepper in a big roasting tin; add the water. Roast at 220°C for 20 min.

Toss chicken with the rest of the oil, the zest of 2 lemons and more oregano and pepper; nestle among the potatoes. Roast 30–35 min, until the chicken is golden and the potatoes have soaked up the juices.
Grate ½ cucumber, squeeze out the water; mix with yoghurt and snipped dill.
Salad: chop cucumber, tomato and pepper; snip the spring onion; add olives, crumbled feta, vinegar, oil and oregano.
Squeeze the last lemon over the tin before serving.

recipes.name: Pastitsio (Greek baked pasta with beef & béchamel)
ingredients: 800 g beef mince (nötfärs); 2 tbsp olive oil
200 g frozen chopped onion; 2 carrots, grated
2 tbsp tomato purée; 1 tsp cinnamon, ½ tsp ground allspice, 1 tsp dried oregano, 2 bay leaves, black pepper
2 × 400 g crushed tomatoes; 1 dl water
400 g wholewheat penne
Béchamel: 50 g butter, 5 tbsp plain flour, 7 dl milk, ¼ tsp nutmeg, 1 egg, 60 g parmesan, grated
400 g frozen broccoli, to serve
steps: Brown mince in oil in two batches until deep brown. Add onion and carrot; cook until the water is gone, 8 min.
Add purée, cinnamon, allspice and oregano; fry 2 min. Add tomatoes, water and bay; simmer 30 min until thick. Remove the bay.
Cook pasta 2 min short of the pack time; drain, mix into the sauce and spread in a large baking dish.
Béchamel: melt butter, stir in flour for 1 min, then whisk in the milk a little at a time; simmer 5 min until thick. Off the heat, whisk in nutmeg, egg and half the parmesan.
Pour over the pasta and top with the rest of the parmesan. Bake at 200°C for 30 min until golden; rest 10 min.
Steam the broccoli and serve alongside.
recipes.note: Freezes well — freeze 1 portion as buffer.

recipes.name: Kerala-style coconut fish curry with brown rice
ingredients: 800 g frozen cod (torsk), thawed, in chunks
150 g frozen chopped onion; 4 cm ginger, grated; pinch of asafoetida (hing), if you have it; 2 tbsp rapeseed oil
1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp garam masala; 1 tbsp tomato purée
500 ml coconut milk (2 × 250 ml); 400 g crushed tomatoes; 2 dl water
300 g frozen green beans (haricots verts)
1 lime; chilli flakes for adults
3 dl brown rice
steps: Start the rice.
Cook onion in oil until the water is gone and it turns golden, 8–10 min. Add ginger, hing, spices and purée; fry 2 min.
Add coconut milk, tomatoes and water; simmer 10 min. Add the beans; 5 min more.
Slide in the fish and simmer gently 5–6 min, until it flakes. Stir as little as possible.
Finish with lime juice; serve with rice and chilli at the table.

recipes.name: Mushroom, kale & white bean barley risotto
ingredients: 3 dl pearl barley (korngryn)
400 g mushrooms (champinjoner), sliced; 2 tbsp olive oil; 1 tbsp butter
100 g frozen chopped onion; 1 tsp dried thyme; black pepper
1.2 l hot water or unsalted stock; parmesan rind (optional)
150 g kale (grönkål), torn; 1 can white beans, rinsed
50 g parmesan, grated; 1 lemon; flat-leaf parsley
steps: Fry mushrooms in oil on high heat in two batches until deep brown, 6–8 min each; set aside.
Cook onion in the same pan until the water is gone and it turns golden. Add barley and thyme; toast 2 min.
Add the water a ladle at a time with the parmesan rind; simmer 35–40 min, stirring often, until creamy and just tender.
Stir in kale, beans and mushrooms for the last 5 min.
Off the heat, stir in butter, parmesan, lemon zest and juice, lots of pepper and parsley.

recipes.name: Lemongrass chicken rice-noodle bowls with herbs & lime
ingredients: 700 g chicken thigh fillets, thawed
2 lemongrass stalks, finely chopped; 4 cm ginger, grated; 1 tbsp rapeseed oil, 1 tsp sesame oil; ½ tsp turmeric; black pepper
250 g rice noodles
2 carrots, in ribbons; 1 cucumber, in sticks; 1 little gem lettuce
Dressing: 2 limes, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 2 tbsp rapeseed oil, 2 cm ginger, grated, 1 spring onion, snipped; chilli flakes for adults
Fresh mint and basil; 1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted
steps: Toss chicken with lemongrass, ginger, oils, turmeric and pepper; leave 10 min.
Air fry at 200°C for 14–16 min, shaking halfway, until charred at the edges; slice.
Cook noodles per the pack; rinse in cold water.
Whisk the dressing.
Build bowls: noodles, carrot, cucumber, lettuce, chicken, lots of mint and basil, dressing and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Panko-lemon cod, air-fryer chips & buttered corn
ingredients: 400 g frozen cod, thawed
1 egg; 1 dl panko; 1 lemon; black pepper
700 g potatoes, in chips; 1 tbsp rapeseed oil; ½ tsp smoked paprika
250 g frozen sweetcorn; 1 tsp butter
1 dl Turkish yoghurt
steps: Toss chips with oil and paprika; air fry at 200°C for 18–20 min, shaking twice.
Dip cod in beaten egg, then in panko mixed with lemon zest and pepper. Air fry in the second air fryer at 200°C for 10–12 min.
Heat corn with butter; mix yoghurt with lemon juice as a dip.

items: Flat-leaf parsley × 2 pots, dill × 1 pot, mint × 1 pot, basil × 1 pot
Plain flour (vetemjöl), baking powder — if out
Chicken thigh fillets (kycklinglårfilé) 1.9 kg (freeze 700 g for Thu)
